tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis tshe dpag lha dgu'i sgrub mchod dkyil 'khor bdag 'jug gsal byed bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā na ye/ 'dir ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i tshe dpag lha dgu'i sgrub mchod 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang las/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang thams cad rdzogs par blang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa de'i gsal byed ngag 'don phreng chags su bkod na/ las bum gyi chu 'thung zhing 'thor ba dang / ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī hūm̐ bar spyi 'gre bzhin/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'ang spyi 'gre bzhin la ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs nas bzhugs su gsol bar gsum/ gdong 'ching tshul dang oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma na hūm̐/ me tog len tshul dang / ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad ring du bskrad/ las bum gyi chu 'thor zhing a mṛ ta'i sngags lan kha shas/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa tā yā mi/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ ho/ sid+dha badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ mgor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/

ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /rdo rje dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la mgo dud la/ hūm̐ dza hūm̐/ thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar te/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ 'di gong gi gsol btab kyi rjes su byas kyang rung ngo / /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab sogs dkyil chog gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub zhu ba'i yon du sogs me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig bdag la 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rang gi lus la phog pas rang skad cig tsam gyis tshe dpag tu med par gyur pa'i snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dmar po de nyid dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gnyis ka las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga nas thim pas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / paṇ+ḍi ta dang / khams kyi rgyal phran la sogs pa thams cad kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dang / tshe dang bsod nams dang / dpal 'byor dang / gzi brjid thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug sogs gong bzhin/

de bzhin du 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i lha dang klu dang drang srong dang / grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi tshe 'dzin cing tshe gnas pa'i nus pa thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par bkug ste rang gi spyi bo'i sogs/ de bzhin du rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang / dbang thams cad dang / 'byung ba sa rdo dang ri brag dang / rtsi shing dang / nags tshal dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / nor bu dang / sman dang / sgyu rtsal la sogs pa'i bcud thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par bkug ste rang gi spyi bo'i sogs/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad dang / khyad par du yang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can dang / yon tan dpag tu med pa la sogs pa na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus la thim/ de bzhin du mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las kyang de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byon te thim par gyur/ sde tshan re re bzhin nam thams cad rdzogs pa'i mthar sngags thung gnyis kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya aḥ.aḥ zhes mang du brjod cing rol mo dang bcas pas ye shes phab la/ de'i rgyun brtan pa'i spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag cing / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod me tog 'bul tshul dang / oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ me tog mgor bzhag tshul dang / pra ti gṛh+ṇa satwaṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba las gdong g.yogs phye tshul dang / rdo rje sems dpas deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ āḥh+ye badz+ra sh+ya/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang mngon sum du mjal ba yin no/

/maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs/ dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal sbyar/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' bskor kun tu mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i khri de nyid kyi steng du rang skad cig tsam gyis hrīḥdamar po las tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i sogs bdag bskyed bzhin/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe dpag med kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa can la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃbadz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ lan gcig rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te/ /bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas/ /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ bai ro tsa na a yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi sa mā ya a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ bum chu 'thung / dril gsil me tog 'thor zhing gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ /mi yi seng ge sbyin pa'i stobs rtogs te/

/snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na/ /sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sgra ni grags par 'gyur/ /sbyin pa mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /de bzhin du sbyin pa'i gnas su tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab rnams bcug la 'don pa spo/ mthar/ ces gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas ye shes kyi chus lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag khyad par du skye ba snga ma rnams su nyon mongs pa gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te gzhan gyi srog gcod pa la brten nas tshe 'dir tshe thung bar gyur ba'i las sgrib ci bsags pa thams cad rnam snang tshe dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ rnam bum dpral bar bzhag lus la rdo rje tshe dbang bskur/ sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra a yur+dz+nyā na sogs kyi mthar/ sbyin pa'i sogs 'dra/ nyon mongs la zhe sdang gi sogs dang / rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ de bzhin du bum pa rna ltag g.yas/ lus la rin chen sogs dang / oṃ rat+na a yur+dz+nyā na sogs kyi mthar/ sbyin pa'i sogs dang / nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser snas sogs dang / rin chen tshe dpag tu med pa sogs 'dra/ ltag par bum pa/ lus la sogs dang / oṃ pad+ma ā yur+dz+nyā na sogs dang / nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi sogs dang / pad+ma tshe dpag tu med pas sogs 'dra/ rna ltag g.yon par bum pa/ lus la las kyi sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra karma ā yur+dz+nyā na sogs dang / nyon mongs pa phrag dog sogs dang / las kyi tshe dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pa gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ thal mo gnyis kyis mthe bong gnyis dang / mthe'u chung gnyis so sor gshibs sor mo lhag ma rnams brkyangs pa pad+ma'i phyag rgya slob ma'i spyi bor gtugs te/

oṃ pad+mo bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ dbang gi dngos gzhi'o/ /mtha' rten bkru byab la rnam bum nas las bum du cung zad blugs la/ de nas 'thung zhing / bum pa g.yon gyis bzung / g.yas kyi ku shas gtor la/ oṃ na mo bh+rūṃ zhes sogs snying po dang / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ bdag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du shān+tiṃ man chad 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ nad thams cad༞ gdon thams cad༞ rims thams cad༞ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad༞ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba༞ 'khon dang grib dang mi gtsang ba༞ byad dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa༞ bkra mi shis pa༞ mtshan mo nag mo dang / dus kyi zhags pa dang / gshin rje'i pho nya༞ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa༞ rgyal po dang the'u rang gi gnod pa༞ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa༞ btsan dang rmu'i gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ bum pa bzhag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ku shas byab tshul dang / gong gi sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa nā ya swāhā/ de bzhin du gong gi shān+tiṃ ku ru thams cad a pa na yar bsgyur/ spyi bo/ mdun rgyab/ dpung gnyis pus gnyis rnams su rdo rje rgya gram bya tshul dang / mthar lus thams cad la bskor zhing / bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ rang gi snying ga'i rtsa bzhi pad 'dab bzhir gyes pa'i dbus su rnam snang tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med gtso 'khor lnga dang ye shes tshe dpag med rnams bzhugs/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas ye shes tshe dpag tu med pa mar me'i phreng ba ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon te rang gi spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i ye shes tshe dpag med la thim pas/

de 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur pa spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te snying kha'i rigs lnga la thim pas rigs lnga zhu ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang ste/ de lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten du gnas par gyur/ rdo rje spyi bo/ sngags gsum po bzla/ de ltar lan gnyis gsum mam lan gcig mthar/ nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun tu brnyas pa spong bar gyis/ /'chi bdag chen po ngas bcom pas/ /bu khyod tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ /oṃ na mo bh+rūṃ nas hūm̐ hrīḥ'i bar gsum/ rgyal srid sna bdun so so'i phyag rgya bcas la gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang / /sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baiḍūr+ya/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing / /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ gzugs mdzes blta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/ /pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ /yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ btsun mo rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ wasti rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ gang yang rgyal la gti mug mdangs ldan pa'i/ /gser sogs mang po thugs la phul ba ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan pa'i/ /blon po rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mā hā ta rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che/ rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog nus pa'i/

/rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ a shwa rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong gyur pa'i/ /ma lus bdud dpung 'jig par byed pa ste/ /dpa' brtan 'byor ba'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ /dmag mi rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ khaṅga rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad la las bum gyi chu 'thor tshul dang / a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ maṅga la aṣ+ṭa dra byaḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir bdag kyang me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes rgya tsho chen po yi/ /ye shes rgya tsho mchog tu dag gyur cig /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che sa srung gis gi waṃ phyag tu phul ba na sogs dang / gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba na sogs dang / zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dur ba phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sngar gyi rigs 'gres sbyar la/ dur was tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/

/rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha tshangs pas shing tog bil ba phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs dang / bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bu bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis deng kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul ba na sogs dang / dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la bram ze skal rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu phul ba na sogs dang / li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyas srid rab tu brtan gyur pas/ /bkra shis des kyang khyod srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu phul ba na sogs dang / yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /me tog dang bcas pas thal sbyar/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang / deng nas sogs spyi 'gre bzhin no/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis rang gi re skong dang gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ ngor chen dkon lhun gyi tshe dpag lha dgu'i sgrub mchod dkyil 'khor bdag 'jug
